title: Catering Order Checklist
subtitle: Capture menu line, guarantee date, production count, and delivery; confirm dietary instruction and client signoff.
description: Catering Order records menu line, guarantee date, production count, delivery, dietary instruction, and client signoff. Catering Order evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this catering order stage-gated verification when staff must document menu line and guarantee date. Reconcile production count, delivery, dietary instruction, and client signoff before the catering order handoff. Use the signed order, menu-line worksheet, guarantee confirmation, kitchen production count, delivery ticket, dietary flag, service-equipment list, and receiving signature. Ask the assigned catering order reviewer to confirm menu line against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Catering Order starting details review
sections.guidance: Capture menu lines, per-person or tray quantities, guarantee date, production count, delivery address, dietary instructions, service equipment, and client signoff.

sections.title: Catering Order checks and corrections review
sections.guidance: Check current catering order facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Catering Order required checks
items: Menu line is identified for this record
Guarantee date matches the current request or source
Production count is ready for point-of-use staff
Delivery limits or questions are resolved
Dietary instruction is communicated to the responsible person
Client signoff is confirmed at handoff
A changed catering order fact is returned for review

blocks.label: Catering Order failed or pending items

sections.title: Catering Order exception review and readiness
sections.guidance: Hold catering order readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Catering Order reviewer receipt

fields.label: Service lead or responsible manager and date

blocks.guidance: Catering Order receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
